The main method supplies 7 mmol copper chloride dihydrate and 4 mmol Te, a 100 mL vessel, 85% solvent filling, 160 °C for 10 h and vacuum drying at 60 °C for 4 h. The solvent volume is not separately printed as mL and is not silently converted.
